item.title: Trump says Russia and Ukraine agree to an 'energy ceasefire'
item.description: President Trump said Sunday that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an "energy ceasefire," but he offered no details on it and Kyiv reported attacks by Moscow on energy sites after his statement.
item.content:encoded:
President Trump said Sunday that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an "energy ceasefire," but he offered no details on it and Kyiv reported attacks by Moscow on energy sites after his statement.

item.title: Tropical Storm Rachel downgraded as high winds and rain turn inward
item.description: Forecasters say the storm, which brought heavy rain and coastal flooding, is a preview of what may be in store as California braces for a possibly record-setting El Niño.

item.title: Hurricane Simon pounds resorts and vulnerable towns along Mexico's Pacific coast
item.description: Hurricane Simon pounded Mexico's Pacific coast as a Category 3 storm on Sunday, as its most powerful winds and rain slammed people living between the Sierra Madre and the ocean.

item.title: Don't be scared: Being afraid is outright fun, and maybe useful
item.description: Listeners of NPR's Weekend Edition Sunday may already know that host Ayesha Rascoe loves horror. But why do scream queens (and kings) like her like what's frightening? The answer may surprise you.

item.title: She was a global star: Teen bikes 700 miles carrying injured dad. Where is she now?
item.description: Her epic ride — carrying her injured dad on her $20 hot pink bicycle — made headlines. Promises were made — financial help, training for a cycling career, even a movie deal. Were any of them kept?

item.title: Sweating the details: Sauna's potential health benefits draw scientists' interest
item.description: A group of international researchers is pushing to rigorously study the potential health benefits of sauna and other heat therapies. They hope to bring scientific legitimacy to the age-old practices.

item.title: It's taking longer to find a new job after losing one
item.description: People who lose their jobs in this economy are taking longer to find new work. Nearly four in ten people exhaust their unemployment benefits before they land a new job.

item.title: In one of the country's most competitive districts, a Democrat tries to keep her seat
item.description: In a highly competitive Washington congressional race, the incumbent Democrat has angered part of her party base and the Trump-backed Republican challenger faces backlash against the party in power.
